heading: Facial expressions for calls and GIF emojis for text chats, making emotional communication available anytime.

blocks.html: We consider about how to use our design to mitigate the technical constrain, enhancing the naturalness and immersion of human-AI interactions. Taking development feasibility into account, we landed on the ideas for text and call chats.
⚙️ Technical: Utilizes facial animations to visually indicate AI processing, reducing perceived response delays and enhancing interaction fluidity.
⏰ Time: Technically feasible and can be implemented within a constrained development timeframe.
